card.name: Odd letter pieces inside coined names
card.fires_on: Short letter chunks like ug, bg, VG or q in the middle of unusual drug names, brand names or random strings. Most often the 'ug' inside ertugliflozin.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A short letter chunk in the middle of a new generic or brand drug name.

modes.label: Random strings
modes.description: A lone letter or chunk inside a URL code or rare foreign word.
